g.text: Title: Project SCCI RH S4 / RHD2216 / sixteen sampled differential streams

g.desc: Title: Project SCCI RH S4 / RHD2216 / sixteen sampled differential streams

g.text: Native digital circuit slice; artificial signals only; external supervisors/power/PCB remain

g.desc: Native digital circuit slice; artificial signals only; external supervisors/power/PCB remain

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Spinal concept: 16 positive contacts + 1 shared reference + separate passive bias; amplifier linearity and biological recording remain conditional.

g.desc: Spinal concept: 16 positive contacts + 1 shared reference + separate passive bias; amplifier linearity and biological recording remain conditional.

g.text: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / ARTIFICIAL SIGNALS / NO PCB OR IMPLANT QUALIFICATION

g.desc: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / ARTIFICIAL SIGNALS / NO PCB OR IMPLANT QUALIFICATION

g.text: CMOS mode: LVDS_en=0; negative SPI pins NC; unused aux inputs at VDD; auxout NC; elec_test and VESD at AFEAGND.

g.desc: CMOS mode: LVDS_en=0; negative SPI pins NC; unused aux inputs at VDD; auxout NC; elec_test and VESD at AFEAGND.

g.text: Configure, calibrate and verify readback via SPI before valid data. 4MHz / 5us command slots are the revised isolated-link study baseline.

g.desc: Configure, calibrate and verify readback via SPI before valid data. 4MHz / 5us command slots are the revised isolated-link study baseline.

g.text: ADC response is pipelined; physical sample timestamps and invalid blanking/recovery intervals must be retained in software.

g.desc: ADC response is pipelined; physical sample timestamps and invalid blanking/recovery intervals must be retained in software.

g.text: Every minus input shares AFE_REF. This is 16 differential streams from 18 functional recording ports, not 32 independent recording electrodes.

g.desc: Every minus input shares AFE_REF. This is 16 differential streams from 18 functional recording ports, not 32 independent recording electrodes.
